description: Crystal-side Term-7 shell-correction sum for ⁴He, S_crystal(⁴He) ≈ −0.991241.  Structural prediction from Schur–Weyl + Wedderburn + categorical R-matrix action evaluated at the crystal limit q → 0 — no free parameter.  Trust profile {axiom: 3, mathlib-cited: 1, derived: 2, script-cited: 2, computational: 1}; the two SCRIPT_CITED frontiers are (a) crystal-limit characters (closes when `conj:crystal-graph-realization` is proven or class-axiomatised per CLAUDE.md §3b-cond), and (b) atomic braid words (inherits the open `atomic_braid_recipe` frontier).  α_5 itself becomes the AME-calibrated proportionality `Term7(A) = α_5 · S_crystal(A)`, atom-independent under flat transport q → 0 ⇝ q_0; this chain replaces PR #481's σ_shell-α_5-skeleton (which marked α_5 as the open frontier — closed structurally on 2026-05-09).

steps.name: Schur–Weyl decomposition of H_{12}(q) ↺ V^{⊗12}
steps.operation: By Schur–Weyl duality (FirstPrinciple `Schur`), the Hecke algebra `H_{12}(q)` acts on `V^{⊗12}` and the centraliser of `U_q(sl_2)` decomposes as a direct sum of irreducibles indexed by partitions `λ ⊢ 12`.  The atomic ⁴He braid is realised in the Markov closure of this 12-strand braid algebra (n = 3A for A = 4).

steps.name: Height-6 partition enumeration of n = 12
steps.operation: Per `def:confinement-level`, GB-filtration level ℓ = 5 corresponds to partitions `λ` with `height(λ) ≤ 6`.  Mathlib's `Mathlib.Combinatorics.Young.YoungDiagram` exposes the partition lattice; enumerating partitions of `n = 12` with at most 6 parts gives 58 partitions (matches `term7-height6-partition-enum.witness.json`).

steps.name: Wedderburn block dimension f_λ via hook-length formula
steps.operation: By Wedderburn (FirstPrinciple `Wedderburn`), each Schur–Weyl summand `M_{f_λ}(K(q))` has block dimension `f_λ = #SYT(λ) = n! / ∏_{x ∈ λ} h_x(λ)` (hook-length formula).  Computed for each of the 58 height-6 partitions of 12; the largest block has `f_λ = 7700` for `λ = (5, 3, 2, 1, 1)`.

steps.name: Plancherel weights w_λ(q = 1) = f_λ² / n!
steps.operation: The Markov weight `w_λ(q) = (q − q^{-1})^{n − ℓ(λ)} / ∏ [h_x]_q` evaluated at `q = 1` reduces to the Plancherel measure on partitions: `w_λ(1) = f_λ² / n!`.  This is the q → 1 classical limit, a pure-algebra specialisation of step 3.  No new content beyond the Wedderburn dimensions and the convention `[k]_1 = k`.

steps.name: Categorical R-matrix action of B_{12} on V^{⊗12}
steps.operation: By the categorical-action axiom (FirstPrinciple `Cat.Action`), each generator `σ_i ∈ B_n` acts on `V^{⊗n}` via the Drinfeld–Jimbo R-matrix at strand `i`.  The action commutes with Schur–Weyl, so it descends to the partition blocks; on each block `M_{f_λ}` it gives the Hoefsmit-seminormal q-character `χ^λ(σ_i; q)`.

steps.name: Crystal-limit χ_λ_crystal at q → 0
steps.operation: Per `conj:crystal-graph-realization`, the q → 0 limit of `χ^λ(β; q)` is the trace of a signed-permutation action on the standard Young tableaux of shape `λ`.  Concretely, each generator `σ_i` acts on `T ∈ SYT(λ)` by the sign of the axial distance `ρ_T(i) = c(T_{i+1}) − c(T_i)` between cells containing `i` and `i + 1` (zero when neither cell exists).  This is computed by `term7_alpha5_crystal_derivation.crystal_chi_lambda`.
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/term7_alpha5_crystal_derivation.py (crystal_chi_lambda).  CONDITIONAL on `conj:crystal-graph-realization` per the witness's `conditional_on` field; closes when either the crystal-graph realisation conjecture is proved (or axiomatised as a class per CLAUDE.md §3b-cond) or a Lean formalisation of the q → 0 functor lands.

steps.name: ⁴He atomic braid word β_⁴He ∈ B_{12}
steps.operation: The ⁴He atomic braid word is `[1, 2, -1, 4, 5, -4, 7, -8, 7, 10, -11, 10]` in `B_{12}` (4 nucleon braids of 3 strands each, joined by the Markov closure).  Supplied by `atomic_braid_gb_filtration_extension.py`.
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/atomic_braid_gb_filtration_extension.py.  Inherits the open `atomic_braid_recipe` frontier already noted in `DERIVATION-CHAIN-METHODOLOGY.md` (Open frontier item 1).

steps.name: Crystal-side Term 7 sum S_crystal(⁴He)
steps.operation:
Combine steps 4 (Plancherel weights), 6 (crystal characters), and 7 (atomic word):
  S_crystal(⁴He) := Σ_{λ ⊢ 12, height(λ) ≤ 6} w_λ(q = 1) · χ_λ_crystal(β_⁴He).
Pure algebra given the inputs; no free parameter.

steps.name: S_crystal(⁴He) numerical evaluation
steps.operation: Numerical evaluation of the symbolic sum from step 8 via `term7_alpha5_crystal_derivation.py` (sympy 1.14, rational arithmetic).  The full per-partition contribution table is in the witness file under `atoms[3].nonzero_contributions`.
